sentences.text: ORDER "Learned counsel for the respondents No.1 to 6

has placed on record the certificate issued by the Doctor to substantiate that there is urgency and need for the amount and hence sought permission for Lunch Motion, which was accepted in view of the aforesaid reason.
Heard.
Ms. Shalini, learned counsel representing Sri Harinath Reddy Soma, learned counsel for the appellant and Sri N.Siva Sal Krishna Reddy, learned counsel for the respondents No.1 to 6.
Earlier this Court on 04.09.2025 passed order permitting the respondents No.1, 5 and 6 to withdraw their respective shares vide I.A.No.1 of 2025.

It is also not out of place to mention that this Court in (.A. No.1 of 2025 observed that the rnmors can only seek withdrawal of the amounts so deposited only after making an application to declare |them as majors on their attaining majority.
Today, lA No.2 of 2025 and I.A, No.3 of 2025 are filed seeking permission to declare respondents No.4 and 2 respectively as majors.

and in support of the same, their Aadhar cards and S.S.C.
Certificates
are furnished.

On perusing the said documents and in the light of the earlier directions issued by this Court on 04.10.2025, these I.A.Nos.2 and 3 of 2025 are also allowed, declaring the petitioners in these applications as majors and also granting permissidn to withdraw said amounts so apportioned to the petitioners.
Post the matter on 24.10.2025 under the caption 'for hearing*."
